title: Sir Pecksalot! - One hit mid air jousting JS game
author: AnythingOne4351
selftext:
Hello all! Previous post got deleted due to incomplete dev process. Be sure that I am all in for learning and spreading methods on the same. Down below:

Game idea was my part

Heavy use of Deepseek v4.1 Flash Free. High effort for planning and Low effort for building. I always make sure to get my best bang for the buck by using about 15% percent of the session context. Ofc, include an [AGENTS.md](http://AGENTS.md) update with every commit.

For 3d assets, I've used the WAM method to generate 3d models and animations, via Bledner MCP. Mesh and animation clean up was done by myself. Use of Deepseek and Blender MCP. Claude was used as a criticizor, basically makes sure Deepseek does the right job and keeps comparing with real world game style references.

Audio was initially procedurally generated, and then baked into mp3 files. Manual cleanup here too.  Again, Deepseek too.

And yeah, this process took about 1 week (weekends mostly). This is a free to play game.
